title: Security: no secret scan on push or PR, no CODEOWNERS, no dependabot, 1 of 595 action uses SHA-pinned
note: REPO READ 2026-11-11 (166 workflows): the only secret scan is gitleaks-history-weekly (schedule + dispatch), red for 3 weeks on false positives (row GITLEAKS-HISTORY-FALSE-POSITIVES); no .gitleaks.toml; no CODEOWNERS; no dependabot.yml; first-party actions are tag-pinned. 50 workflows hold contents:write. No workflow alerts when a file under .github/workflows changes on main (detector D4). UNVERIFIED: GitHub native secret scanning and push protection (repo setting). Good news from the same sweep: 0 workflows use pull_request_target, 0 lack a permissions block, all 79 issue-triggered workflows require the issue author to be the repo owner, 0 inline attacker-controlled text into a shell.
